questions.question: Do you enforce multi-factor authentication for privileged and administrative accounts?
questions.insurer_relevance: UK cyber insurers routinely ask whether administrator access is protected by MFA because privileged credential compromise drives high-impact claims.

supporting_findings.title: Privileged role assignments without MFA enforcement
evidence: 1 privileged account(s) do not have MFA enabled
Conditional access for privileged administrators was not observable and is treated as unmet for deterministic scoring
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Require MFA and admin-focused conditional access for privileged identities.

questions.evidence_statement: CRIS-SME identified material evidence that this control area is not fully met. The strongest linked gap is IAM-001 at 67.97 risk (high priority).
questions.recommended_next_step: Require MFA and admin-focused conditional access for privileged identities.

questions.question: Do you limit privileged access and review high-risk permissions regularly?
questions.insurer_relevance: Insurers assess whether privileged access is narrowly scoped and reviewed because excessive privilege expands ransomware and fraud blast radius.

supporting_findings.title: Identity governance observability is partial for this assessment scope
evidence: Subscription-scoped evidence was collected for privileged role assignments
Tenant-wide Entra controls such as conditional access were not directly observable in this run
The signed-in assessment identity exposed 1 Entra directory role(s)
The tenant directory-role catalog was partially visible with 43 active role entry(ies)
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Broaden tenant-level identity evidence collection before treating IAM coverage as complete.

questions.evidence_statement: CRIS-SME identified partial evidence of control weakness or incomplete observability. The strongest linked gap is IAM-005 at 4.57 risk (monitor priority).
questions.recommended_next_step: Broaden tenant-level identity evidence collection before treating IAM coverage as complete.

questions.question: Are administrative services and internet-facing rules restricted to least-privilege network access?
questions.insurer_relevance: Publicly reachable administrative services and permissive firewall rules are common signals in cyber insurance questionnaires and underwriting reviews.

supporting_findings.title: Administrative services are exposed to the public internet
evidence: 1 asset(s) expose RDP to the public internet
1 asset(s) expose SSH to the public internet
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Restrict SSH and RDP exposure with private access paths, VPN, or just-in-time controls.

supporting_findings.title: Network security group rules are broader than expected
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Tighten overly permissive network rules to least-privilege source and port scopes.

questions.evidence_statement: CRIS-SME identified material evidence that this control area is not fully met. The strongest linked gap is NET-001 at 72.12 risk (high priority).
questions.recommended_next_step: Restrict SSH and RDP exposure with private access paths, VPN, or just-in-time controls.

questions.question: Are critical workloads patched promptly and protected with endpoint or anti-malware controls?
questions.insurer_relevance: Patch latency and missing endpoint protection are frequent prerequisites for claims involving ransomware and exploitation of known vulnerabilities.

supporting_findings.title: Critical workloads remain unpatched beyond acceptable risk tolerance
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Patch critical workloads and enforce a stronger recurring patch policy.

supporting_findings.title: Endpoint protection coverage is below the expected workload baseline
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Deploy endpoint protection or security agents to uncovered workloads.

supporting_findings.title: Workload hardening baseline coverage is incomplete
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Apply a hardened workload baseline across compute resources and administrative settings.

questions.evidence_statement: CRIS-SME identified partial evidence of control weakness or incomplete observability. The strongest linked gap is CMP-001 at 42.69 risk (planned priority).
questions.recommended_next_step: Patch critical workloads and enforce a stronger recurring patch policy.

questions.question: Do you maintain resilient backups for critical workloads and business data?
questions.insurer_relevance: Backup recoverability is a core underwriting concern because it directly affects business interruption exposure and ransom resilience.

supporting_findings.title: Backup and retention coverage fall below resilience expectations
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Increase backup and retention coverage for business-critical data stores.

supporting_findings.title: Workload backup agent coverage is below resilience expectations
evidence: Workload backup agent coverage is approximately 0%
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Enable workload backup protections for critical virtual machines and services.

questions.evidence_statement: CRIS-SME identified material evidence that this control area is not fully met. The strongest linked gap is DATA-003 at 37.58 risk (planned priority).
questions.recommended_next_step: Increase backup and retention coverage for business-critical data stores.

questions.question: Do you retain logs, generate security alerts, and maintain incident response procedures?
questions.insurer_relevance: Cyber insurance applications often ask for logging, alerting, and response evidence to gauge the organisation's ability to detect and contain incidents.

supporting_findings.title: Activity log retention is below governance and investigation expectations
evidence: Activity logs are retained for only 0 day(s)
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Increase log retention to support investigation, governance review, and evidence preservation.

supporting_findings.title: Security monitoring coverage is below the expected baseline
supporting_findings.remediation_summary: Expand security monitoring coverage across workloads and key cloud services.

questions.recommended_next_step: Increase log retention to support investigation, governance review, and evidence preservation.
